verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a managed DGX system, since its management stack could plausibly offer it, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only conventional management interfaces (BMC, KVM, Redfish, IPMI) and llms.txt documentation aimed at AI agents. Neither is a first-party way to operate the B300 through natural-language commands; llms.txt is adjacent documentation, not product control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
